content: When the newly-opened Promise Land Casino floods Chucalissa with scrilla, our hometown heroes learn that mo’ money does indeed bring mo’ mayhem. Dreamers, schemers, ballers, and shot callers alike come from far and wide for a dance with chance— but are they willing to put their souls on the line for a legendary bag? Back at The Pynk, Uncle Clifford dreams of expanding her empire while Roulette breaks the club’s cardinal rule to build hers. As Lil’ Murda’s gang ties threaten to clip his wings, a caged Keyshawn fights to break free and take flight. chineseContent: 当新开业的应许之地赌场让楚卡丽莎充斥着乱七八糟的内容时，我们家乡的英雄们了解到，金钱确实会带来混乱。梦想家、阴谋家、舞者和指挥家都从四面八方赶来，与机会共舞——但他们愿意为了一款传奇包袋而赌上自己的灵魂吗？回到平克俱乐部，克利福德叔叔梦想着扩大她的帝国，而轮盘则打破俱乐部的基本规则来建立她的帝国。当小穆达的帮派关系威胁到他的翅膀时，被关在笼子里的基肖恩奋力挣脱并飞翔。房子可能会玩重骰子，但喧嚣总会获胜。 #Starz #PValley 订阅 STARZ YouTube 频道：http://bit.ly/1kalhP0 Facebook：http://starz.tv/STARZFacebookYT Instagram：http://starz.tv/STARZInstagramYT YouTube：https://starz.tv/STARZYouTube TikTok：https://starz.tv/STARZTikTokYT P-Valley 追踪在肮脏三角洲工作的脱衣舞俱乐部舞者的生活。
